n, b = map(int, input().split())

array = list(map(int, input().split()))

oddCounter = [0] * n
evenCounter = [0] * n

if array[0] % 2 == 0:
    evenCounter[0] = 1
else:
    oddCounter[0] = 1

for i in range(1, n):
    if array[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCounter[i] = evenCounter[i - 1] + 1
        oddCounter[i] = oddCounter[i - 1]
    else:
        oddCounter[i] = oddCounter[i - 1] + 1
        evenCounter[i] = evenCounter[i - 1]

costList = []

for i in range(n - 1):
    if evenCounter[i] == oddCounter[i]:
        costList.append(abs(array[i] - array[i + 1]))

costList.sort()

totalCost = 0
cuts = 0

for c in costList:
    if totalCost + c <= b:
        totalCost += c
        cuts += 1
    else:
        break

print(cuts)
